text: 4.1 Hold a foreign passport, be in good health, and abide by Chinese laws and the regulations of JUST. 4.2 Undergraduate students should hold a high school diploma and be generally under 30 years old; master's degree holders should have a bachelor's degree and be generally under 40 years old; doctoral degree holders should have a master's degree and be generally under 45 years old. 4.3 The language proficiency requirements for applicants of English-taught programs are as follows. For bachelor's degree programs - 75 points on the IBT or 5.5 points on the IELTS; for master's or higher degree programs - 80 points on the IBT or 6 points on the IELTS. However, no such requirements apply to native English speakers. For Chinese-taught programs, applicants must have a recent HSK 4 certificate (within two years).
